Composable rows/columns computing absolute positions.

The preset renderer lays out fixed boxes by hand; this module packages that arithmetic so custom cards can do the same: split a box into a row or a column, inset padding, then draw each cell with direct nvg calls. Spans (ogimage/spans) are the Layer-0 text primitive; nothing here runs at draw time, positions are plain floats (nvg has layouting but absolute is faster for now).

An absolute rect in user units: origin plus size.

Carve b into a top-to-bottom column of absolute heights. Cells keep full width; leftover space stays empty at the bottom.

    OgBox] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Like splitColumn but heights share the available space proportionally to weights. Non-positive totals split evenly.

Carve b into a left-to-right row of absolute widths. Cells keep full height; leftover space stays empty on the right and overflow is the caller's problem.
